headline: Last session: Indian markets ended Friday's trade as investors prepared for a long weekend and monitored global cues.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Market is closed for the weekend and an upcoming holiday, reopening on Tuesday.
Tata Trusts has declared the reappointment of Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran as void.
Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and crude oil price volatility are impacting sentiment.
Strong growth in India's software services exports was reported by the RBI for FY26.
whatHappening: A leadership dispute has surfaced between Tata Trusts and the Tata Sons Board over the Chairman's role.
Mazagon Dock, RVNL, and Nestle India are identified as key stocks to watch for the next trading session.
RBI data indicates software services exports reached $221.4 billion, an 8.2% increase in FY26.
A new SME IPO for Liqvd Digital India is scheduled to open on September 23.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed and will reopen on Tuesday, September 22, 2026. The weekend is marked by a major leadership conflict at Tata Sons and positive RBI data on software exports. Investors are also keeping a close watch on West Asia tensions and global commodity prices.
